boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Alabama at Birmingham, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe first-weekend route that starts on campus and branches into Birmingham’s public cultural and outdoor places.

cards.title: Start by getting oriented on the Campus Green
cards.subtitle: First stop · UAB’s central outdoor green space
cards.notes: Walk the sidewalks around the Green to locate the Recreation Center, Dining Commons, residence halls, and University Boulevard before making other plans.
cards.short_summary: Use the central lawn as an easy visual anchor for your first campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB describes the Campus Green as an open space bounded by University Boulevard, the Recreation Center, Dining Commons, residence halls, and other campus buildings.
cards.source_title: Campus Green | University of Alabama at Birmingham
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus green space; check the university calendar for scheduled events.

cards.title: Make the Hill your indoor reset point
cards.subtitle: Second stop · 1400 University Blvd.
cards.notes: Use the building map or information desk to find dining, the bookstore, student services, and reservable spaces; confirm weekend hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A practical campus hub for meals, information, and a break indoors.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB describes the Hill Student Center as a communal place with meals, books, student services, meetings, and activities.
cards.source_title: Hill Student Center | University of Alabama at Birmingham
cards.access_notes: The official page lists abbreviated summer hours; schedules can change.

cards.title: Check the dining map for Magic City Eats
cards.subtitle: Meal stop · UAB Campus Dining
cards.notes: Look up the current campus dining map and hours, then choose Magic City Eats if it is operating during your visit and its location fits your route.
cards.short_summary: A named UAB Campus Dining option to check when planning a campus meal.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB Campus Dining identifies Magic City Eats as one of its dining locations and provides a locations-and-hours page.
cards.access_notes: Consult UAB Dining’s current locations-and-hours page before going; food requires purchase or an eligible dining balance.

cards.title: Tour the Campus Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Active afternoon · 1501 University Blvd.
cards.notes: Bring your ONE Card if you are an eligible UAB student, then pick one facility feature to try or simply get familiar with the building next to the Green.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility with courts, aquatics, fitness space, and more.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB says currently enrolled students have Recreation Center access included in tuition and identifies the center at 1501 University Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Student Services & Facilities | UAB Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: Eligible UAB students should bring a ONE Card; facility access and program availability are subject to university policies.

cards.title: Try the climbing wall if you have member access
cards.subtitle: Active option · Campus Recreation Center mezzanine
cards.notes: Ask Recreation staff about current wall access, required instruction, and equipment before climbing; choose the bouldering wall or a scheduled program that fits your comfort.
cards.short_summary: A structured, on-campus climbing option within the Recreation Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB documents a 36-foot climbing wall and a 12-foot bouldering wall in the Campus Recreation Center, open to URec members.
cards.source_title: Student Services & Facilities | UAB Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: Access is for URec members; ask staff about current wall hours, requirements, and programming.

cards.title: Set aside a quiet stop at Sterne Library
cards.subtitle: Campus pause · 917 13th St. S.
cards.notes: Use the library as a calm place to review the weekend, find a study seat, or ask at a service point; check its current weekend hours before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A named UAB library stop with published visitor-access guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB’s library access guidelines state that non-UAB visitors may access Sterne Library during library open hours and list Saturday hours of 9 a.m.–5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Visitor access is limited to library open hours; verify the current calendar and any access requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Take an evening walk at Railroad Park
cards.subtitle: Off-campus outdoor stop · Birmingham
cards.notes: Use the park’s posted entrances and paths for an easy outdoor stretch, then head out before closing; keep any route and transport plan simple and daylight-aware.
cards.short_summary: A public Birmingham park with long daily hours and no entrance fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Railroad Park states that it is open daily from 7 a.m. to 11 p.m. and has no entrance fee.
cards.access_notes: Officially open 7 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; the park advises using its entrances and provides parking guidance.

cards.title: Continue along Rotary Trail
cards.subtitle: Downtown connector · four-block walking/running/biking path
cards.notes: Use the trail for a short, self-paced connection between downtown landmarks; yield to other users and turn back if your group’s daylight or transport plan changes.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped downtown trail that links Railroad Park toward Sloss Furnaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Birmingham Rotary Club describes Rotary Trail as a four-block walking, running, and biking path that connects Railroad Park and Sloss Furnaces.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public trail; plan a return route and follow posted conditions.

cards.title: See Birmingham’s industrial history at Sloss Furnaces
cards.subtitle: Weekend culture stop · 20th Street North area
cards.notes: Take the self-guided route through the historic site, pause at the interpretive features, and verify the day’s hours before leaving campus for this destination.
cards.short_summary: A preserved industrial landmark with free general admission and self-guided touring.
cards.evidence_claim: Sloss Furnaces states that admission is free, self-guided tours are available, and normal weekend hours are Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. and Sunday noon–4 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official normal hours list Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. and Sunday noon–4 p.m.; guided or special tours may carry a fee.

cards.title: Finish with a gallery visit at Birmingham Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Downtown cultural stop · 2000 Reverend Abraham Woods Jr. Blvd.
cards.notes: Choose a few collection galleries rather than trying to cover everything, and check the museum calendar for closures or exhibition-specific ticketing before you travel downtown.
cards.short_summary: A downtown art museum whose general admission covers collection galleries and most exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Birmingham Museum of Art says general admission is free every day and includes collection galleries and most exhibitions unless otherwise noted.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Birmingham Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by day, and the official page notes planned closures and possible exhibition exceptions; confirm before visiting.
